literal: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, bore the taboo name Hong; he was Xianzu, Emperor Xianwen's eldest son; his mother was Lady Li.
idiomatic: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, bore the taboo name Hong. He was the eldest son of Xianzu, Emperor Xianwen; his mother was Lady Li.

literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Huangxing, on the wushen day, he was born in the Purple Palace at Pingcheng; divine light shone within the chamber, heaven and earth were hazy, and harmonious qi filled all.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Huangxing, on the wushen day, he was born in the Purple Palace at Pingcheng. Divine light shone within the chamber, heaven and earth were hazy, and harmonious qi filled all.

literal: At birth he was fair and white, with an unusual bearing; even in swaddling clothes he was precocious, and as he grew he was deep, generous, benevolent, and filial, clearly showing the marks of a ruler.
idiomatic: At birth he was fair and white, with an unusual bearing. Even in swaddling clothes he was precocious; as he grew he was deep, generous, benevolent, and filial, clearly showing the marks of a ruler.

literal: Xianzu especially loved and prized him.
idiomatic: Xianzu especially loved and prized him.

literal: In the sixth month of summer of the third year, on the xinwei day, he was installed as crown prince.
idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer of the third year, on the xinwei day, he was installed as crown prince.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the dinghai day, the Tiele of the Wo'ye and Tongwan garrisons rebelled.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dinghai day, the Tiele of the Wo'ye and Tongwan garrisons rebelled.

literal: An edict ordered Grand Commandant Wang Yuanhe of Longxi to pursue and attack; reaching Fuhan, he destroyed them and took more than thirty thousand heads;
idiomatic: An edict ordered Wang Yuanhe, Grand Commandant and Prince of Longxi, to pursue and attack. Reaching Fuhan, he destroyed them and took more than thirty thousand heads;

literal: their scattered fugitives were relocated to Ji, Ding, and Xiang provinces as camp households.
idiomatic: their scattered fugitives were relocated to Ji, Ding, and Xiang provinces as camp households.

literal: On the gengyin day, General Who Campaigns East, Prince of Nan'an Zhen, was made acting commissioner, Area Commander of Liangzhou and of all western Rong armies, Colonel Protector of the Western Regions, with equipage equal to the Three Directors, and garrisoned Liangzhou.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day Zhen, General Who Campaigns East and Prince of Nan'an, was made acting commissioner, area commander of Liangzhou and of all western Rong armies, colonel protector of the Western Regions, with equipage equal to the Three Directors, and garrisoned Liangzhou.

literal: The man of Shuofang Cao Pingyuan gathered malcontents, broke Stone Tower Fortress, and killed military officers.
idiomatic: Cao Pingyuan of Shuofang gathered malcontents, broke Stone Tower Fortress, and killed military officers.

literal: Liu Yu's general Yuan Chongzu led twenty thousand men from Yuzhou to raid Dong Yanzhou and encamped at Nanchenggu.
idiomatic: Yuan Chongzu, Liu Yu's general, led twenty thousand men from Yuzhou to raid Dong Yanzhou and encamped at Nanchenggu.

literal: In the eleventh month, Inspector Yu Luohou defeated them; Chongzu returned to Yuzhou.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month Inspector Yu Luohou defeated them, and Chongzu returned to Yuzhou.

literal: The sorcerer-rebel Sima Xiaojun gathered a band and rebelled at Pingling; Inspector of Qi Province, Prince of Wuchang Pingyuan, attacked and captured him.
idiomatic: The sorcerer-rebel Sima Xiaojun gathered a band and rebelled at Pingling; Pingyuan, inspector of Qi province and Prince of Wuchang, attacked and captured him.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the yiyou day, Chief Commandant of Attendant Cavalry Mu Liang was made Prince of Zhao commandery.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yiyou day, Mu Liang, chief commandant of attendant cavalry, was made Prince of Zhao commandery.

literal: On the renchen day, an edict sought descendants of Shun; a man of Donglai commandery, Gui Gouzhi, was found; his household was restored for all generations, to manifest the imperishability of supreme virtue.
idiomatic: On the renchen day an edict sought descendants of Shun. Gui Gouzhi, a man of Donglai commandery, was found, and his household was restored for all generations to manifest the imperishability of supreme virtue.

literal: The former Prince of Puyang Kongque's original enfeoffment was restored.
idiomatic: The former Prince of Puyang Kongque's original enfeoffment was restored.

literal: On the xinchou day, Prince of Zhao commandery Mu Liang was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Changle.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day Mu Liang, Prince of Zhao commandery, was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Changle.

literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the yimao day, the Hu people of Tongwan garrison rebelled in succession and fled north.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the yimao day, the Hu people of Tongwan garrison rebelled in succession and fled north.

literal: An edict ordered General Who Pacifies the South, Duke of Jiaozhi Han Ba, and others to pursue and destroy them.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Han Ba, General Who Pacifies the South and Duke of Jiaozhi, and others to pursue and destroy them.

literal: The chief of the Dayang Man, Huan Dan, led his households to submit inward; he was appointed General Who Campaigns South and enfeoffed Prince of Xiangyang.
idiomatic: Huan Dan, chief of the Dayang Man, led his households to submit inward; he was appointed General Who Campaigns South and enfeoffed Prince of Xiangyang.

literal: A partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital and west of the Yellow River, south to Qin and Jing, west to Fuhan, and north to the garrisons of Liangzhou.
idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital and west of the Yellow River, south to Qin and Jing, west to Fuhan, and north to the garrisons of Liangzhou.

literal: An edict named Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Xing You envoy to Liu Yu.
idiomatic: An edict named Xing You, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to Liu Yu.

literal: Second month, day yisi: an edict said: "Confucius received the bearing of a sage who penetrates all, embodied the measure of innate knowledge, exhausted principle and fulfilled nature, and his Way illumined the four seas.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the yisi day, an edict said, "Confucius received the bearing of a sage who penetrates all, embodied the measure of innate knowledge, exhausted principle and fulfilled nature, and his Way illumined the four seas.

literal: Recently Huai and Xu have not yet submitted, and the temples lie beyond reach; this has caused the sacrificial canon to lapse and ritual statutes to perish, so that sorceresses and shamans advance what is not ritual, kill living creatures for drum-dances, and actors and jesters behave indecently—how can this honor the spirits and revere the sage's Way?
idiomatic: Recently Huai and Xu have not yet submitted, and the temples lie beyond reach; this has caused the sacrificial canon to lapse and ritual statutes to perish, so that sorceresses and shamans advance what is not ritual, kill living creatures for drum-dances, and actors and jesters behave indecently—how can this honor the spirits and revere the sage's Way?

literal: From this time forward, when sacrificing at Confucius's temple, use only wine and dried meat; do not allow women to mingle in the rites to pray for undeserved blessings.
idiomatic: From this time forward, when sacrificing at Confucius's temple, use only wine and dried meat; do not allow women to mingle in the rites to pray for undeserved blessings.

literal: Offenders are to be judged for violating regulations.
idiomatic: Offenders are to be judged for violating regulations.

literal: When the public offices have business, follow the usual rites as before.
idiomatic: When the public offices have business, follow the usual rites as before.

literal: Victims and grain offerings must be made fully abundant and pure.
idiomatic: Victims and grain offerings must be made fully abundant and pure.

literal: When performing the rites, show reverence so that all is solemn; the pastoral officials are to clearly investigate lawlessness and ensure that prohibitions are enforced.
idiomatic: When performing the rites, show reverence so that all is solemn; the pastoral officials are to clearly investigate lawlessness and ensure that prohibitions are enforced.

literal: The Rouran raided the frontier.
idiomatic: The Rouran raided the frontier.

literal: The Supreme Emperor halted at the northern suburb and ordered the generals to attack them.
idiomatic: The Supreme Emperor halted at the northern suburb and ordered the generals to attack them.

literal: The barbarians fled and withdrew.
idiomatic: The barbarians fled and withdrew.

literal: Their separate commander Agan led more than a thousand encampments to surrender.
idiomatic: Their separate commander Agan led more than a thousand encampments to surrender.

literal: The eastern Tiele rebelled and fled to the Rouran; the Supreme Emperor pursued them to Shiji but, unable to overtake them, returned.
idiomatic: The eastern Tiele rebelled and fled to the Rouran; the Supreme Emperor pursued them to Shiji but, unable to overtake them, returned.

literal: On the renzi day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the renzi day the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third month: the Supreme Emperor returned from the northern campaign.
idiomatic: In the third month the Supreme Emperor returned from the northern campaign.

literal: On the wuchen day, Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, Chief Commandant of Attendant Cavalry Wan Anguo, was made Grand Marshal and Grand General and enfeoffed Prince of Ancheng.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day Wan Anguo, palace attendant of scattered cavalry and chief commandant of attendant cavalry, was made grand marshal and grand general and enfeoffed Prince of Ancheng.

literal: On the wuwu day, the imperial carriage plowed the sacred field.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day the imperial carriage plowed the sacred field.

literal: Shicheng commandery captured Cao Pingyuan and sent him to the capital, where he was executed.
idiomatic: Shicheng commandery captured Cao Pingyuan and sent him to the capital, where he was executed.

literal: The Tiele of Lianchuan plotted rebellion; they were relocated and assigned to Qing, Xu, Qi, and Yan provinces as camp households.
idiomatic: The Tiele of Lianchuan plotted rebellion; they were relocated and assigned to Qing, Xu, Qi, and Yan provinces as camp households.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengzi: an edict that artisans, merchants, and miscellaneous performers were all permitted to return to farming.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengzi day, an edict permitted artisans, merchants, and miscellaneous performers to return to farming.

literal: All provinces and commanderies were charged to urge the people to plant more vegetables and fruit.
idiomatic: All provinces and commanderies were charged to urge the people to plant more vegetables and fruit.

literal: On the xinhai day, Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the guiyou day, an edict that monks were not to leave their monasteries and wander among the people; travelers must carry official documents.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day an edict forbade monks to leave their monasteries and wander among the people; travelers had to carry official documents.

literal: That month Liu Yu died; his son the younger Liu Yu usurped the throne.
idiomatic: That month Liu Yu died; his son the younger Liu Yu usurped the throne.

literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: an edict that military alerts were to be supplied with seals and tallies first, and horse brands second.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingsi day, an edict ordered that military alerts be supplied with seals and tallies first and horse brands second.

literal: [1] Sixth month: the people of An province suffered hail; they begged remission of rent and relief.
idiomatic: [1] In the sixth month the people of An province suffered hail; they begged remission of rent and relief.

literal: On the bingshen day, an edict said: "Recently when provinces and commanderies selected tribute candidates, many were not according to fact; thus worthy men are stranded in remote corners while base men overstep and advance rashly—is this what is called honoring the worthy and planting virtue?
idiomatic: On the bingshen day an edict said, "Recently when provinces and commanderies selected tribute candidates, many were not according to fact; thus worthy men are stranded in remote corners while base men overstep and advance rashly—is this what is called honoring the worthy and planting virtue?

literal: This year's selections were especially coarse and excessive.
idiomatic: This year's selections were especially coarse and excessive.

literal: From this time forward, all who are sent must be the highest of their gate in the province and commandery, and the utmost choice of village and hamlet."
idiomatic: From this time forward, all who are sent must be the highest of their gate in the province and commandery, and the utmost choice of village and hamlet."

literal: Intercalary month, day renzi: the Rouran raided Dunhuang; the garrison commander Wei Duohou drove them off.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the renzi day, the Rouran raided Dunhuang; the garrison commander Wei Duohou drove them off.

literal: They also raided Jinchang; the defending commander Xue Nu drove them off.
idiomatic: They also raided Jinchang; the defending commander Xue Nu drove them off.

literal: On the wuwu day, the court traveled to Yinshan.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day the court traveled to Yinshan.

literal: Seventh month of autumn: Sun Yan of Guang province and others gathered a band of more than a thousand and rebelled, communicating with the younger Liu Yu; Inspector Shusun Gui suppressed and pacified them.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Sun Yan of Guang province and others gathered a band of more than a thousand and rebelled, communicating with the younger Liu Yu; Inspector Shusun Gui suppressed and pacified them.

literal: On the xinchou day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the renyin day, an edict that each province, commandery, and county was to send two men of talent fit for specialized replies, to attend the ninth-month martial review, when the ruler would personally question them on local customs.
idiomatic: On the renyin day an edict ordered each province, commandery, and county to send two men of talent fit for specialized replies to attend the ninth-month martial review, when the ruler would personally question them on local customs.

literal: [2] Eighth month, day bingchen: the state of Baekje sent envoys with a memorial requesting troops to attack Goryeo.
idiomatic: [2] In the eighth month, on the bingchen day, the state of Baekje sent envoys with a memorial requesting troops to attack Goryeo.

literal: On the xinyou day, the states of Didouyu and Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute; the state of Changting sent envoys presenting Shu horses.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day the states of Didouyu and Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute; the state of Changting sent envoys presenting Shu horses.

literal: The Feiye Tou of Hexi rebelled; the Bogu'lu garrison commander drove them off.
idiomatic: The Feiye Tou of Hexi rebelled; the Bogu'lu garrison commander drove them off.

literal: Ninth month, day xinsi: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinsi day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

literal: On the wushen day, the Tongwan garrison commander, Prince of Hejian Yan Hupi, was sentenced to death for greed and cruelty.
idiomatic: On the wushen day Yan Hupi, Tongwan garrison commander and Prince of Hejian, was sentenced to death for greed and cruelty.

literal: On the jiyou day, an edict remitted field rent where eleven provinces and garrisons had suffered flood, and ordered granaries opened for relief.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day an edict remitted field rent where eleven provinces and garrisons had suffered flood, and ordered granaries opened for relief.

literal: Another edict that all fugitive and scattered people were to return to their origins; violators were to be assigned to frontier garrisons.
idiomatic: Another edict ordered all fugitive and scattered people to return to their origins; violators were to be assigned to frontier garrisons.

literal: Tenth month of winter: the Rouran raided the frontier as far as Wuyuan.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Rouran raided the frontier as far as Wuyuan.

literal: Eleventh month: the Supreme Emperor personally campaigned against them, intending to cross the desert and strike.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Supreme Emperor personally campaigned against them, intending to cross the desert and strike.

literal: When the Rouran heard the army had come, they were greatly afraid and fled north several thousand li.
idiomatic: When the Rouran heard the army had come, they were greatly afraid and fled north several thousand li.

literal: Because the exhausted foe had fled far, they could not be pursued, and the campaign halted.
idiomatic: Because the exhausted foe had fled far, they could not be pursued, and the campaign halted.

literal: On the dinghai day, the Emperor's uncle Lue was enfeoffed Prince of Guangchuan.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day the emperor's uncle Lue was enfeoffed Prince of Guangchuan.

literal: On the renchen day, envoys were dispatched separately to tour and inspect local customs and inquire into the people's hardships.
idiomatic: On the renchen day envoys were dispatched separately to tour and inspect local customs and inquire into the people's hardships.

literal: Each month the Emperor paid court at Chongguang Palace.
idiomatic: Each month the emperor paid court at Chongguang Palace.

literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu: an edict said: "The Documents say: 'Every three years conduct a review; after three reviews promote the enlightened and demote the obscure.'
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu day, an edict said, "The Documents say: 'Every three years conduct a review; after three reviews promote the enlightened and demote the obscure.'

literal: Recently officials have been promoted for mere toil and replaced before long; governors and magistrates have no mind to comfort the people but compete in amassing wealth, seeing off the old and welcoming the new in endless succession on the roads—this is not how to fix the people's will and exalt the way of rule.
idiomatic: Recently officials have been promoted for mere toil and replaced before long; governors and magistrates have no mind to comfort the people but compete in amassing wealth, seeing off the old and welcoming the new in endless succession on the roads—this is not how to fix the people's will and exalt the way of rule.

literal: From this time forward, governors and magistrates who are warm, benevolent, pure, and frugal and who restrain themselves and serve the public may hold office for long.
idiomatic: From this time forward, governors and magistrates who are warm, benevolent, pure, and frugal and who restrain themselves and serve the public may hold office for long.

literal: When year after year they accumulate achievement, advance them one rank.
idiomatic: When year after year they accumulate achievement, advance them one rank.

literal: Those who are greedy, cruel, and contrary to the Way and who encroach on the common people, though they have just taken office, must be demoted and punished.
idiomatic: Those who are greedy, cruel, and contrary to the Way and who encroach on the common people, though they have just taken office, must be demoted and punished.

literal: Inscribe this in the statutes as an eternal standard."
idiomatic: Inscribe this in the statutes as an eternal standard."

literal: An edict that because Dai commandery was comparable to Feng and Pei, all Dai people previously assigned to frontier garrison duty were exempted.
idiomatic: An edict held that because Dai commandery was comparable to Feng and Pei, all Dai people previously assigned to frontier garrison duty were exempted.

literal: Third year, spring, first month, day gengchen: an edict that Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Cui Yan was envoy to the younger Liu Yu.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the gengchen day, an edict named Cui Yan, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to the younger Liu Yu.

literal: On the dinghai day, Chongguang Palace was renamed Ningguang Palace.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day Chongguang Palace was renamed Ningguang Palace.

literal: On the wuxu day.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day.

literal: The Supreme Emperor returned to Yunzhong.
idiomatic: The Supreme Emperor returned to Yunzhong.

literal: That month, Xiang province seized and sent the sorcerer Rong Yong'an to the capital, where he was executed.
idiomatic: That month Xiang province seized and sent the sorcerer Rong Yong'an to the capital, where he was executed.

literal: An edict pardoned his associates.
idiomatic: An edict pardoned his associates.

literal: Second month, day wushen: Goryeo and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the wushen day, Goryeo and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the guichou day, an edict that governors, magistrates, and chiefs were diligently to lead the people and not let them miss the seasons.
idiomatic: On the guichou day an edict charged governors, magistrates, and chiefs diligently to lead the people and not let them miss the seasons.

literal: Within the same district, rich and poor were to aid one another.
idiomatic: Within the same district, rich and poor were to aid one another.

literal: Households with an extra ox were to lend to those without; if they did not obey the edict, no one in the gate might hold office for life.
idiomatic: Households with an extra ox were to lend to those without; if they did not obey the edict, no one in the gate might hold office for life.

literal: Magistrates who did not supervise were removed from office.
idiomatic: Magistrates who did not supervise were removed from office.

literal: On the wuwu day, the Supreme Emperor returned from the northern campaign, held a drinking ceremony and recorded merit, and reported to the ancestral temple.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day the Supreme Emperor returned from the northern campaign, held a drinking ceremony and recorded merit, and reported to the ancestral temple.

literal: Those who died in royal service had their households restored.
idiomatic: Those who died in royal service had their households restored.

literal: An edict that within the capital districts, people who died on corvée service, the commanderies and counties were to receive the coffin and supply burial expenses.
idiomatic: An edict ordered that within the capital districts, when people died on corvée service, the commanderies and counties were to receive the coffin and supply burial expenses.

literal: On the jiaxu day, an edict that a county chief who could pacify banditry in one county might concurrently administer two counties and receive both salaries;
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day an edict held that a county chief who could pacify banditry in one county might concurrently administer two counties and receive both salaries;

literal: one who could pacify two counties might administer three, and after three years be transferred to commandery governor.
idiomatic: one who could pacify two counties might administer three, and after three years be transferred to commandery governor.

literal: A two-thousand-dan official who could pacify two commanderies might rise to three, likewise; after three years he was transferred to inspector.
idiomatic: A two-thousand-dan official who could pacify two commanderies might rise to three, likewise; after three years he was transferred to inspector.

literal: Third month, day renwu: an edict that wherever granaries were fully stocked with grain and wheat, the surplus was to be given out to the poor.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the renwu day, an edict ordered that wherever granaries were fully stocked with grain and wheat, the surplus was to be given out to the poor.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day wushen: an edict that Acting Minister of Works, Prince of Shangdang Changsun Guan, and others were to campaign against Tuyuhun Sheyin.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wushen day, an edict ordered Changsun Guan, acting minister of works and Prince of Shangdang, and others to campaign against Tuyuhun Sheyin.

literal: On the renzi day, the Khitan state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the renzi day the Khitan state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: An edict that Kong Sheng of Lu commandery, twenty-eighth-generation descendant of Confucius, was made Grand Master of Veneration of the Sage and given ten households for libation and sweeping.
idiomatic: An edict made Kong Sheng of Lu commandery, twenty-eighth-generation descendant of Confucius, Grand Master of Veneration of the Sage and gave him ten households for libation and sweeping.

literal: Sixth month, day jiazi: an edict said: "In past years the counties summoned two worthy youths from among the people and questioned them on the governors' and magistrates' conduct; good and evil were all heard, with rewards and punishments to follow.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiazi day, an edict said, "In past years the counties summoned two worthy youths from among the people and questioned them on the governors' and magistrates' conduct; good and evil were all heard, with rewards and punishments to follow.

literal: Yet those rewarded were few while those punished were many.
idiomatic: Yet those rewarded were few while those punished were many.
